body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk tool page block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat This? Rabbit Food Checker
URL: /can-rabbits-eat-this/

How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the "Can Rabbits Eat This?" page.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old page content with everything below.

SEO plugin settings:
SEO title: Can Rabbits Eat This? Rabbit Food Checker
Meta description: Use our rabbit food checker to search common fruits and vegetables and see whether rabbits can eat them, how often, what to remove and when to avoid them.
Focus keyphrase: can rabbits eat this
URL slug: can-rabbits-eat-this
-->

<section class="rcfood-page alignfull" id="rabbit-food-checker">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-safe-soft: #eff8ed;
      --rc-caution-soft: #fff5df;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcfood-page,
    .rcfood-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcfood-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcfood-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rcfood-page a:focus-visible,
    .rcfood-page button:focus-visible,
    .rcfood-page input:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rcfood-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcfood-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcfood-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcfood-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcfood-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rcfood-btn,
    .rcfood-search-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcfood-btn:hover,
    .rcfood-search-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rcfood-btn-primary,
    .rcfood-search-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rcfood-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcfood-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcfood-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rcfood-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcfood-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.72), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.34) 48%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.06)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcfood-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcfoodFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcfood-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 850px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcfood-hero-title-overlay .rcfood-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rcfood-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcfood-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 620px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcfood-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rcfood-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rcfood-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcfood-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcfood-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rcfood-hero-card,
    .rcfood-panel,
    .rcfood-side-card,
    .rcfood-tool,
    .rcfood-result,
    .rcfood-food-card,
    .rcfood-tip,
    .rcfood-related-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcfood-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcfood-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rcfood-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rcfood-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rcfood-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rcfood-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rcfood-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rcfood-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcfood-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rcfood-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rcfood-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rcfood-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rcfood-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rcfood-section-header { max-width: 790px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rcfood-section h2,
    .rcfood-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcfood-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rcfood-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rcfood-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcfood-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rcfood-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcfood-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcfood-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rcfood-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcfood-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rcfood-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcfood-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rcfood-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rcfood-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcfood-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }

    .rcfood-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcfood-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcfood-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rcfood-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    /* Food checker */
    .rcfood-tool-section {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcfood-tool {
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rcfood-search {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: clamp(18px, 3vw, 26px);
      border-radius: 30px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rcfood-search label {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcfood-search input {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 58px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      background: #ffffff;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rcfood-search input::placeholder { color: rgba(111, 106, 97, 0.72); }

    .rcfood-chip-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .rcfood-chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 40px;
      padding: 9px 13px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rcfood-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcfood-result {
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 34px);
      border-radius: 34px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.2), transparent 18rem),
        #ffffff;
    }

    .rcfood-result-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .rcfood-status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 10px 15px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-weight: 950;
    }

    .rcfood-status.safe { background: var(--rc-safe-soft); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }
    .rcfood-status.treat { background: var(--rc-caution-soft); color: #7a5a1a; }
    .rcfood-status.caution { background: var(--rc-caution-soft); color: #7a5a1a; }
    .rcfood-status.avoid,
    .rcfood-status.toxic { background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcfood-result h3 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.65rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .rcfood-result p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 720;
    }

    .rcfood-result-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .rcfood-mini {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
    }

    .rcfood-mini strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }

    .rcfood-mini span {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 850;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rcfood-result-link {
      justify-self: start;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      min-height: 48px;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #ffffff !important;
      font-weight: 950;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.22);
    }

    .rcfood-result-link::after { content: "→"; }

    .rcfood-all-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcfood-food-card {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 230px;
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #fff;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .rcfood-food-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rcfood-food-emoji {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      right: 18px;
      font-size: 3.4rem;
      opacity: 0.18;
      line-height: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcfood-food-card h3 {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.16rem;
      line-height: 1.15;
      max-width: 78%;
    }

    .rcfood-food-card p {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .rcfood-tag {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-self: flex-start;
      margin-top: auto;
      padding: 7px 11px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--rc-safe-soft);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 950;
    }

    .rcfood-tag.treat,
    .rcfood-tag.caution { background: var(--rc-caution-soft); color: #7a5a1a; }

    .rcfood-tag.avoid,
    .rcfood-tag.toxic { background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rcfood-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rcfood-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rcfood-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rcfood-warning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.06rem; }

    .rcfood-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rcfood-warning-list li {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 850;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rcfood-tips-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rcfood-tip {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcfood-tip:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }

    .rcfood-tip b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
    }

    .rcfood-tip h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcfood-tip p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcfood-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rcfood-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-apples.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;

          return names.some(function (name) {
            const n = normalise(name);
            return n === q || n.indexOf(q) !== -1 || q.indexOf(n) !== -1;
          });
        }) || null;
      }

      function showFood(food) {
        if (!food) {
          status.className = "rcfood-status caution";
          status.textContent = "Not found";
          category.className = "rcfood-status";
          category.textContent = "Try another search";
          title.textContent = "I do not have that food in the checker yet.";
          summary.textContent = "If you are unsure whether a food is safe for rabbits, do not feed it. Check with a rabbit-savvy vet or a trusted rabbit welfare source first.";
          frequency.textContent = "Unknown";
          amount.textContent = "Do not feed if unsure";
          prepare.textContent = "Check first";
          warning.textContent = "Unknown foods may be unsafe";
          link.href = "/what-do-rabbits-eat/";
          link.textContent = "Read the rabbit diet guide";
          return;
        }

        status.className = "rcfood-status " + food.status;
        status.textContent = food.label;
        category.className = "rcfood-status";
        category.textContent = food.category;
        title.textContent = "Can rabbits eat " + food.name.toLowerCase() + "?";
        summary.textContent = food.summary;
        frequency.textContent = food.frequency;
        amount.textContent = food.amount;
        prepare.textContent = food.prepare;
        warning.textContent = food.warning;
        link.href = food.url;
        link.textContent = "Read the full guide";
      }

      function renderCards() {
        if (!cards) return;

        const guideFoods = foods.filter(function (food) {
          return food.url;
        }).slice().sort(function (a, b) {
          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        });

        cards.innerHTML = guideFoods.map(function (food) {
          return '<a class="rcfood-food-card" href="' + food.url + '">' +
            '<span class="rcfood-food-emoji">' + food.emoji + '</span>' +
            '<h3>' + food.name + '</h3>' +
            '<p>' + food.summary + '</p>' +
            '<span class="rcfood-tag ' + food.status + '">' + food.label + '</span>' +
          '</a>';
        }).join("");
      }

      if (form) {
        form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
          event.preventDefault();
          showFood(findFood(input.value));
        });
      }

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-food]").forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener("click", function () {
          input.value = button.getAttribute("data-food");
          showFood(findFood(input.value));
        });
      });

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-rcfood-jump]").forEach(function (linkEl) {
        linkEl.addEventListener("click", function () {
          const value = linkEl.getAttribute("data-rcfood-jump");
          setTimeout(function () {
            input.value = value;
            showFood(findFood(value));
            input.focus();
          }, 120);
        });
      });

      if (input) {
        input.addEventListener("input", function () {
          const food = findFood(input.value);
          if (food) showFood(food);
        });
      }

      renderCards();
    })();
  </script>
